about: PreToolUse guard for Bash. Each rule is a Python regex matched against the whole command. A match blocks the command and the reason is shown to the agent. Server-specific rules (production paths, hosts, container names) go in guard-rules.local.json next to this file, which is gitignored; same shape.

rules.reason: Production compose file. Production is deployed by a human; agents never build, start or stop it.
Deployment, backup and data-sync scripts change shared environments. Ask the owner to run them.
Host services and timers are operated by a human.
No remote shells or copies from agent sessions; servers are reached only through the deployed apps.

Starts, stops or rebuilds a compose stack. On shared servers the compose project name can collide with a running environment (rebuild.sh db also wipes data). Environments are operated by a human; tests need no running stack.
Destroys database or volume data. Backend tests use a throwaway MySQL (harness/lib/backend-tests.sh); nothing else should drop data.
The shared databases hold production data (or a copy of it). Query only the throwaway test database jmlpcz_test*.
Secrets are never read into the agent context. Use .env.example files and placeholders.
No force pushes. Use a new commit or a new branch.
main is updated only through reviewed pull requests.
Discards work irreversibly. Stash or branch instead.
Do not bypass git hooks; fix what they report.
Recursive delete outside the working tree.
